features.name: Versioned V2 domain models
criteria: FindingV2, IssueCluster, RolePosition, DiscussionTurn, DecisionPoint, UserDecision, Reconsideration, DecisionTrace and ReviewRecordV2 validate conservatively
Missing schema_version is interpreted as a V1 record
Invalid model enums or missing fields cannot create blockers or hard constraints

features.name: Input diagnostics and durable persistence
criteria: Truncation and original/reviewed lengths are explicit
Review IDs are collision-resistant and legacy IDs remain readable
history_mode off, metadata and full are supported with full as default
Writes are atomic and tests use injected temporary storage

features.name: Executable RoleDefinition and CouncilPlan
criteria: Reviewer permissions, evidence policy, blockers and discussion participation are data-backed
Chief editor is an adjudicator rather than a reviewer
Mode and content routing is deterministic and tested

features.name: Model and user interaction runtime abstraction
criteria: Council Core has no direct FastMCP Context dependency
FastMCP adapters support sample and form elicitation
Mocks cover success, malformed output, failure, unsupported, decline and cancel

features.name: Conservative deterministic preflight
criteria: High-confidence placeholder, token, tag, URL and explicit DNT checks are deterministic
Numeric and Markdown differences are non-blocking without explicit constraints
Preflight blockers cannot be authored by sampled reviewer output

features.name: Hybrid issue clustering
criteria: Findings are normalized and grouped by issue rather than reviewer
Hard-coded permissions and named-term conflict cases are removed from the production engine
False merge and false split regression cases are covered

features.name: Targeted bounded deliberation
criteria: Only affected roles see relevant issue packets and positions
No substantive conflict produces no manufactured discussion
Discussion records structured claims and evidence without hidden chain-of-thought
Mode-specific model-call budgets are enforced

features.name: Policy gate and traceable adjudication
criteria: Invalid options are removed before user choice or Council adjudication
Fallback uses a Position Matrix and evidence hierarchy rather than vote counts
Chief-editor decisions trace to constraints, evidence, roles and user input
Indistinguishable valid alternatives request human review

features.name: Default interactive decisions with graceful fallback
criteria: interactive_mode auto is the default
At most three meaningful DecisionPoints are collected in one elicitation form
User choice is decisive among valid options
Unsupported, declined and cancelled interactions complete safely through the configured fallback or return pending

features.name: Continue and targeted reconsideration
criteria: continue_review is the only new public MCP tool
A continuation creates an immutable revision linked to its parent
Context updates and preferences trigger only affected roles
Default responses are compact and the full trace remains retrievable

features.name: V2.1 outcome-first data contracts
criteria: Finding kind and proposed outcome are represented explicitly without treating clean affirmations as issues
Decision options carry stable internal IDs, normalized outcome values and concise user-facing labels
V1 and V2.0 records remain readable while new V2.1 records preserve full and metadata privacy contracts

features.name: Mutually exclusive outcome normalization
criteria: Selectable options are concrete translation outcomes rather than raw reviewer action strings
Equivalent proposed outcomes collapse across roles and cannot multiply influence or choices
DecisionPoints require at least two materially distinct valid outcomes after the Policy Gate

features.name: Goose-readable batched decision form
criteria: One standard MCP form presents no more than three decisions and four concise choices per decision
Internal option IDs are hidden from labels but map safely and deterministically through form values
Every interactive decision offers an explicit option to delegate to Council adjudication

features.name: Budget-aware targeted reconsideration and truthful degradation
criteria: Only contrary or materially affected roles reconsider after a user outcome selection
The standard reference flow completes useful reconsideration within the existing ten-call budget
Skipped or failed required reconsideration is explicit in status, warnings and trace provenance

features.name: Compact deliberation digest and chief-output cleanup
criteria: Compact output exposes the effective task, consensus, material disagreement, decision and bounded evidence basis
Degraded execution and warnings are visible without opening the full record
Chief-editor checklist entries are deduplicated by outcome and evidence target

features.name: V0.5 migration, evaluation and authoritative documentation
criteria: All accepted V0.4 regressions and focused V0.5 counterexamples pass
Version 0.5.0, diagnostic build outcome-first-decision-v3, five tools, review-only boundary and 6/10/14 budgets are verified
A fresh package build and a pinned Goose live-test recipe are delivered with docs aligned to the implemented contract

features.name: Guided pre-review briefing
criteria: Source/target-only reviews trigger one concise Goose form before reviewer sampling when briefing_mode is auto
The briefing collects domain, content location, audience, tone goal, review focus and bounded usage context with an explicit Council-inference option
Rich caller context skips redundant questions while briefing_mode always and off remain explicit and deterministic

features.name: Context normalization and provenance
criteria: Common values such as UI button normalize to the intended review content type instead of silently becoming unspecified
Caller facts, user briefing answers and inferred assumptions retain field-level provenance and deterministic precedence
Declined, cancelled, unsupported and malformed briefing paths are explicit and never fabricate user input

features.name: Adaptive material context gaps
criteria: Reviewers may surface bounded structured context gaps without creating hard constraints or hidden reasoning
At most one follow-up form with two material questions appears only when an answer could change a valid outcome or role judgment
Affected-role context reconsideration is targeted, provenance-rich and budget-aware

features.name: Concise interaction information architecture
criteria: Briefing, context-gap and decision forms use deterministic short titles and non-repeating descriptions
Decision titles derive from safe source/candidate anchors rather than unbounded reviewer problem prose
All form schemas remain flat primitive MCP elicitation schemas that work in normal Goose

features.name: Process-first Council digest
criteria: Default compact output leads with case brief, assumptions, blind spots, role lenses, consensus, minority report and material disagreements
User decisions, reconsideration changes and editor synthesis appear after the deliberation map, with the verdict last
A bounded display report and structured digest expose claims and evidence without hidden chain-of-thought or duplicated reviewer prose

features.name: V0.6 guided-deliberation migration and evaluation
criteria: New records use schema 2.2 while V1, V2.0 and V2.1 remain readable and metadata privacy remains allowlist-based
Version 0.6.0, diagnostic build guided-deliberation-v4, exact five tools, review-only boundary and 6/13/18 budgets are verified
Fresh package artifacts, deterministic guided-session evaluations and pinned Goose briefing/process-first test recipes are delivered

features.name: Primary user-facing MCP process content
criteria: review_translation, continue_review and view_review_record return concise Council Markdown as primary MCP text content while retaining structuredContent
Normal Goose does not need a second prompt or diagnostic checklist to discover the Council process
The exact five-tool surface and all structured review fields remain available

features.name: Adaptive concise Council report
criteria: The default Chinese report uses five or fewer clear sections, places the final disposition last and omits empty interaction sections
A clean six-role case targets 1800 characters and every default report is capped at 3200 Unicode code points
Full structured evidence remains retrievable without duplicating it in the default report

features.name: Truthful consensus and distinct role compression
criteria: Affirmative role evidence contributes to a truthful positive consensus instead of appearing as no consensus
Every active role retains one concise distinct lens with a practical insight and optional evidence anchor
Semantic compression removes repeated praise but never erases a material minority, blocker, disagreement or unavailable role

features.name: Presentation integrity and layered retrieval
criteria: User-facing text excludes internal IDs, English implementation headings, hidden reasoning and unnecessary Policy Gate telemetry
Briefing form titles and accepted values round-trip to tone_goal and primary_focus without transposition
Compact, full and metadata paths preserve review-only, privacy, phase truth and degradation visibility

features.name: V0.7 concise-display migration and evaluation
criteria: Package/module 0.7.0 and diagnostic build concise-council-display-v5 preserve schema 2.2, five tools and 6/13/18 budgets
FastMCP 2.13 and current resolved FastMCP compatibility prove primary text plus structured content on installed wheels
Fresh artifacts, full regressions and a normal-user Goose recipe are delivered for Q-009 revalidation

features.name: Natural primary Council microcopy
criteria: Primary chief-editor text omits procedural decision counters and internal adjudication jargon while structured evidence remains unchanged
Clean affirmative role lenses omit redundant evidence; material blocker, choice, minority and unavailable-coverage evidence remains visible
Known implementation labels render as natural Chinese and optional evidence is never cut mid-token or mid-clause

features.name: V0.7.1 presentation polish migration
criteria: Package/module 0.7.1 and diagnostic build concise-council-display-v5.1 preserve schema 2.2, five tools and 6/13/18 budgets
The accepted live-shaped clean fixture produces concise natural Chinese with no procedural counters or implementation-heavy evidence
Fresh artifacts, full regressions and a pinned normal-user Goose Q-009 revalidation recipe are delivered

features.name: Relevant panoramic marketing Council
criteria: Standard marketing activates exactly six relevant lenses: fidelity, terminology, product context, brand voice, risk ambiguity and fluency
Lightweight remains explicitly narrower and strict never loses a standard marketing lens
Role routing stays deterministic, registry-backed and within the unchanged 6/13/18 budgets

features.name: Material context before wording outcomes
criteria: Brand-versus-functional usage and binding slogan or terminology questions are selected as material even when reviewer prose varies
Material context elicitation and affected-role reconsideration occur before discussion and outcome selection
Answered, duplicate, generic, immaterial and question-limit provenance remains bounded and truthful

features.name: Context confidence and disposition coherence
criteria: Unresolved material context lowers effective confidence and cannot produce an unqualified publishable completion
Declined, unsupported, malformed or assumption-only context prevents premature wording elicitation and requires human review
Actual context answers may continue through bounded reconsideration and a valid user outcome without weakening Policy Gate authority

features.name: Context-first process presentation integrity
criteria: Primary text shows unresolved material context as a blind spot or required confirmation, not as a completed user decision
Issue labels and punctuation are natural Chinese with no raw ux token or doubled full-stop-semicolon sequence
Raw V2.2 runtime and role facts remain internally consistent while no duplicate diagnostic fact sheet or sixth tool is added

features.name: V0.8 context-coherent Council migration
criteria: Package/module 0.8.0 and diagnostic build context-coherent-council-v6 preserve schema 2.2, five tools and 6/13/18 budgets
Fresh artifacts, full regression and current FastMCP installed-wheel smoke pass
Pinned live recipes cover a clean marketing slogan and a deliberately mixed marketing-versus-UI context

features.name: Bounded concurrent independent review
criteria: Only the independent-review phase runs concurrently, with an effective limit between one and three and a default of three
Briefing, context handling, discussion, Policy Gate, adjudication and every reconsideration phase remain ordered and non-overlapping
Six-role standard reviews complete in two bounded waves when the effective limit is three

features.name: Deterministic parallel budget and result integrity
criteria: The complete independent batch reserves budget before model side effects and never exceeds 6/13/18 mode limits
Results, role coverage and persisted role order follow CouncilPlan order regardless of completion order
One failed or malformed role cannot cancel, misassociate or duplicate another role call and no automatic retry spends hidden budget

features.name: Truthful concurrency and wall-clock telemetry
criteria: V2.3 records distinguish end-to-end wall-clock duration from accumulated provider wait
Records expose the effective concurrency limit, actual peak independent-review concurrency and batch count without persisting prompts or model text
V1, V2.0, V2.1 and V2.2 records remain readable with conservative telemetry defaults

features.name: Provider-safe concurrency control
criteria: COUNCIL_REVIEW_CONCURRENCY accepts only 1, 2 or 3; missing configuration defaults to three and invalid configuration falls back to one
get_server_info reports the effective limit and configuration disposition without adding a public MCP tool
Setting the limit to one preserves the established sequential behavior for provider troubleshooting

features.name: V0.9 bounded-parallel migration
criteria: Package/module 0.9.0 and diagnostic build bounded-parallel-council-v7 write schema 2.3 while preserving exactly five tools and budgets 6/13/18
Fresh wheel and sdist plus isolated current-FastMCP smoke verify the installed concurrent path and sequential override
Documentation explains latency semantics, compatibility control and the post-publication Goose gate

features.name: Deterministic Council contribution metrics
criteria: Each active role is classified as unique material, corroborating, confirmation only or unavailable from validated structured artifacts without a model call
Repeated or synonymous findings cannot inflate contribution or authority
Metrics are descriptive diagnostics and never become votes, quality scores or Policy Gate weights

features.name: Marginal discussion value telemetry
criteria: Discussion value counts only new bounded evidence, real position changes or resolved material issues
Rephrased prose alone reports no marginal value
Metric construction adds zero sampling and zero elicitation

features.name: Value-first concise Council presentation
criteria: Primary text leads with material new perspectives and collapses repetitive confirmation while visibly accounting for every active role exactly once
Minority views, unresolved context, degradation and unavailable coverage remain prominent and the chief disposition remains last
Full role feedback, findings, evidence and trace remain available in structured full history

features.name: Eighteen-case Golden evaluation framework
criteria: The deterministic corpus covers all 18 audit scenarios with machine-checkable expected properties
Offline aggregate metrics cover critical recall, false positives, contribution, conflict, user authority, chief consistency, calls and marginal discussion value
Evaluation adds no MCP tool, runtime dependency or live provider call

features.name: V0.10 evidence-value migration
criteria: Package/module 0.10.0 and diagnostic build evidence-value-council-v8 write schema 2.4 while preserving five tools, budgets 6/13/18 and concurrency controls
V1 and V2.0 through V2.3 records remain readable with conservative value defaults
Fresh artifacts, installed-wheel smoke, complete regression and authoritative documentation pass

features.name: V0.10.1 truthful novelty and grouped presentation correction
criteria: Discussion provenance already present in typed rule or immutable-constraint fields cannot be counted as new evidence under a prefixed spelling
Every material corroborated or disputed issue remains intelligible at least once while repeated confirmations and exact-anchor work items stay grouped
Package/module 0.10.1 and build evidence-value-council-v8.1 preserve schema 2.4, five tools, budgets 6/13/18, full structured history and the exact 18-case Golden evidence

features.name: Live-shaped human work-item projection
criteria: Primary text maps repeated deterministic checks and reviewer corroboration for one protected anchor to one human work item without changing full structured issue identity
Distinct semantic defects and materially different consequences remain visible while duplicate chief advice and execution-order prose are suppressed
Package/module 0.10.2 and build evidence-value-council-v8.2 preserve schema 2.4, five tools, budgets 6/13/18, concurrency, review-only behavior and Golden evidence

features.name: Deterministic role-routing profiles
criteria: Every recognized content type and review mode resolves through an explicit stable routing profile rather than an accidental intersection of mode and applicability flags
CouncilPlan persists a bounded routing profile and safe deterministic reason codes without user prose or hidden model reasoning
Existing non-legal UI, marketing, technical-documentation and unspecified portfolios retain their accepted relative order and budgets

features.name: Risk-sensitive panoramic reviewer portfolios
criteria: Legal-risk lightweight, standard and strict routes use the frozen 4/6/7-role portfolios defined by CAMPAIGN-011-r1
Standard legal-risk reviews include product-context, UX-copy and risk-ambiguity perspectives while remaining at six independent samples
No generic legal adviser is added and reviewers must not invent statutes, jurisdictional requirements or legal advice

features.name: Routing provenance and compatibility
criteria: Schema 2.5 records expose routing provenance and remain readable from V1 and V2.0 through V2.4 with conservative defaults
Routing metadata adds zero sampling and zero elicitation and survives full persistence and continuation
The standard deep path remains bounded at 13 calls and strict legal-risk paths remain within 18

features.name: Concise risk-route presentation
criteria: Risk-sensitive primary reports make the selected professional coverage intelligible without exposing internal profile or role IDs
Material scope, consent, authorization, modality, overpromise and user-impact consequences remain visible without duplicate work items
The report retains exactly five sections, the 1200 clean target, the 3200 hard cap and full structured evidence

features.name: Twenty-four-case Golden risk corpus
criteria: The accepted 18-case corpus remains intact and six deterministic legal-risk cases cover scope, consent versus authorization, modality, overpromise, protected tokens and a clean control
All aggregate correctness, contribution, authority, chief, budget and discussion metrics remain machine-checkable at 1.0
Golden evaluation traverses production orchestration and adds no live provider dependency

features.name: V0.11 risk-coherent migration
criteria: Package/module 0.11.0 and diagnostic build risk-coherent-council-v9 write schema 2.5
Exact five tools, review-only default, budgets 6/13/18, concurrency controls and user-authority boundaries remain unchanged
Fresh wheel and sdist, isolated FastMCP smoke, complete regression and authoritative documentation pass

features.name: Canonical client-verifiable evidence receipt
criteria: A versioned receipt_schema_version 1.0 exposes stable record, serving, routing, reviewer-execution, runtime, preflight, issue, outcome, coherence and availability fields with exact documented types
Total sampling calls, independent-review successes, applicable budget, elicitation calls, server wall time and sampling wait are named separately and cannot be conflated
The receipt is deterministically derived from one persisted record plus current server identity and adds zero sampling, elicitation, adjudication or persistence mutation

features.name: Privacy-safe and history-aware receipt projection
criteria: Default receipt channels omit source, candidate, reviewer prose, evidence text, filesystem paths, credentials and internal issue IDs while retaining bounded canonical routing and role IDs
V1, metadata-only and V2.0 through V2.4 records expose unavailable facts as null with deterministic not_recorded_fields instead of compatibility defaults
Unknown or prose-shaped codes are redacted conservatively and hostile persisted prose cannot escape through the receipt

features.name: Verification view on the existing history tool
criteria: view_review_record accepts detail_level=verification without adding a sixth tool or changing the existing full and summary results
The primary Markdown receipt and structured verification_receipt are generated from the same canonical object and preserve exact enum and count values
Normal review_translation and continue_review primary presentation remain byte-compatible and review-only safety remains unchanged

features.name: Receipt coherence, compatibility and privacy evidence
criteria: Live-shaped clean, edit-required and deterministic-blocker fixtures prove exact routing, coverage, calls, budgets and terminal-disposition coherence in both channels
Negative controls cover metadata and legacy availability, unsafe codes, hostile prose, unavailable reviewers, continuation records and zero side effects
The accepted 24-case Golden corpus, complete regression, exact five tools and supported FastMCP dual-channel behavior remain intact

features.name: V0.12 verifiable-evidence migration
criteria: Package and module version 0.12.0 and diagnostic build verifiable-evidence-council-v10 keep persisted Schema 2.5 and advertise receipt schema 1.0
Exact five tools, defaults, review-only boundary, budgets 6/13/18, concurrency 1 through 3 and all routing/adjudication behavior remain unchanged
Canonical root-only lock migration, fresh wheel and sdist, isolated FastMCP smoke, complete regression and authoritative documentation pass

features.name: Normal-Goose canonical receipt text fallback
criteria: The verification TextContent contains the unchanged human receipt followed by one compact parseable canonical verification_receipt JSON object
The appended JSON parses equal to structured_content.verification_receipt and preserves exact field names, enums, nulls, lists, counts and order without model reconstruction
The fallback is privacy-safe and bounded, adds no sampling, elicitation or persistence mutation, and leaves all normal review, continuation, full and summary text unchanged
Package and module 0.12.1 with build verifiable-evidence-council-v10.1 preserve record Schema 2.5, receipt Schema 1.0, five tools, budgets 6/13/18 and concurrency behavior

features.name: Deterministic decision-support assessment
criteria: Schema 2.6 records one deterministic categorical assessment with level well_supported, supported_with_limits or insufficient plus bounded basis and limitation codes
The assessment uses only validated structured trace facts and never averages reviewer confidence, reads free prose or introduces a numeric score
A deterministic blocker can strongly support a needs-human-review disposition; support level never means candidate quality

features.name: Decision-support coherence and compatibility
criteria: Pending interaction, unresolved material context, partial or zero coverage, incomplete required reconsideration and degraded execution classify conservatively as insufficient
Insufficient evidence can only tighten an accidentally permissive chief result to needs human review and no level can relax Policy Gate, blockers or user-authority rules
V1 and V2.0 through V2.5 records load with not_recorded support provenance and metadata history retains only bounded content-free fields

features.name: Concise calibrated support presentation
criteria: The normal five-section report adds at most one concise conclusion-support line before the canonical final disposition
The final disposition remains exactly once and last, clean output remains concise and every report remains under the existing 3200-code-point cap
Verification receipt 1.1 exposes the exact categorical assessment and canonical codes in both channels without changing retrieval purity or the five-tool surface

features.name: Thirty-case calibrated Golden evidence
criteria: The executable Golden corpus expands from 24 to exactly 30 cases with clean, deterministic blocker, material edit, unresolved context, partial coverage and valid-decision calibration controls
All existing eight aggregate metrics remain 1.0 and new metrics prove exact support-level accuracy, zero false reassurance and blocker/disposition coherence
Live-shaped, compatibility, privacy, continuation and hostile-value regressions add no provider call or fixture-authored observation

features.name: V0.13 calibrated-evidence migration
criteria: Package/module 0.13.0 and diagnostic build calibrated-evidence-council-v11 write Review Schema 2.6 and advertise verification receipt Schema 1.1
Exact five tools, review-only defaults, budgets 6/13/18, concurrency 1 through 3, routing portfolios and all non-calibration adjudication behavior remain stable
Canonical root-only lock migration, authoritative documentation, complete regression, fresh artifacts and isolated FastMCP wheel smoke pass

features.name: Fail-closed incomplete-input review
criteria: Any source or candidate truncation is visible in primary, compact and verification channels and cannot be represented as complete coverage
Known truncation deterministically yields degraded execution, insufficient decision support, NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW and 需人工复核 / 是
The repair preserves useful bounded-prefix evidence without adding document chunking or cross-chunk synthesis

features.name: High-precision deterministic token scanning
criteria: Ordinary percentage prose and localized punctuation around URLs cannot create deterministic protected-token blockers
Legitimate printf placeholders, variables, commands, flags, URLs and caller literals retain their current deterministic protection
A dedicated positive and negative corpus proves scanner precision without weakening deterministic authority

features.name: Safe Targeted Discussion envelope degradation
criteria: Malformed or wrong-shaped discussion envelopes are rejected as a whole without an unhandled exception
Invalid discussion preserves the complete pre-discussion matrix and cannot create blockers, actions or position changes
Failure is represented by bounded degradation, warning and phase provenance while valid Round 1 evidence remains usable

features.name: Post-discussion consensus and choice coherence
criteria: Role consensus is recomputed from final material positions after every valid discussion update
Digest, minority report, value metrics and decision support consume the same post-discussion truth
User-choice usefulness remains independent and may persist only because multiple Policy-valid outcomes exist, never because disagreement state is stale

features.name: Privacy-minimized legacy V1 summary
criteria: V1 summary returns only bounded identity, mode, status and terminal disposition metadata
V1 summary excludes task content, source/candidate text, reviewer/conflict prose and full chief rationale
V1 full and verification behavior remain compatible and retrieval remains free of save, sampling and elicitation side effects

features.name: Truthful Golden metrics and blind-evaluation contract
criteria: Existing evaluator metrics are versioned or renamed so their public names match the exact predicates they measure
The deterministic 30-case corpus remains production-path regression evidence and does not claim independent blind quality validity
A machine-readable blind-set contract defines expected issue identity, bounded anchors, severity range, allowed alternatives and forbidden findings for later independent curation

features.name: Evidence-bounded FastMCP compatibility policy
criteria: The supported range is based on actual Goose/runtime requirements plus evidence for the locked 2.13.0.2 floor and isolated 3.4.7 behavior
A justified upper bound, a minimum/current/latest-compatible CI matrix or both prevents unsupported future-major compatibility claims
FastMCP 2.x support is not removed without an explicit downstream compatibility reason
